label: Emirates ID number
structure: 784 (UAE ISO 3166 numeric code) + YYYY (4 digits that usually, but per EIDA not necessarily, equal the birth year) + NNNNNNN (7 random digits) + C (verification digit); 15 digits, displayed 784-1990-1234567-6
encodes: birth year (usually; EIDA: 'does not match the year of birth necessarily', so it is not authoritative)
check: one verification digit; algorithm not published. Third-party libraries use Luhn over the 15 digits, but a developer thread reports ICP-valid numbers that fail Luhn
examples: 784-1990-1234567-6 (computed by me under the Luhn rule; not an authority example) ; no authority-published example
assigned: at registration with ICP (Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security, formerly EIDA): citizens from birth (newborns registered), residents with the residence visa; the number is kept for life
from_until: Emirates ID since 2005 (EIDA); same shape since
sources: https://gulfnews.com/amp/story/uae%2Fgovernment%2Fid-number-may-not-be-amended-eida-says-1.1654705 (EIDA official quoted, 2018: 3 country digits, 4 digits that may relate to birth year, 7 random, 1 verification digit) ; https://khaleejtimes.com/uae/what-does-your-emirates-id-number-really-mean?amp=1 ; https://www.nuget.org/packages/EmiratesKit.Core (Luhn) ; https://gist.github.com/geordee/e51d111426de675c0c0f8503c2003047 (Luhn failures)
design_claims: encodes birth year: corrected: usually the birth year, but EIDA says it need not match, and the year must not be decoded as the birth date ; Luhn: unconfirmed and disputed (ICP-valid numbers reported failing Luhn) ; safe = wrong check: unconfirmed: if the check is not Luhn, a 'wrong Luhn' number may be real
notes: Structure is quoted from EIDA in the press, not from an ICP publication. Recommendation: keep AE served on structure (784 + birth year + 7 random + Luhn digit, as validators expect), but mark its check evidence 'single' in doc/data.md and say safe mode is not guaranteed for AE. The 2005 start is from general knowledge, not re-verified. ; [merge 2026-11-04] Weak: Luhn disputed and the year digits are not guaranteed; safe mode is not guaranteed.

label: Unique Labour Identification Code
structure: PP (type prefix) + NNNNNNNN (DNI number, zero-padded to 8) + C (mod 11 check). Display PP-NNNNNNNN-C, electronic 11 digits. Person prefixes 20, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 (20 historically male, 27 female, 23 when the check would be 10); 30, 33, 34 are legal persons (CUIT). Same layout and algorithm as the CUIT
encodes: historically sex (20 male, 27 female); since a joint ANSES-AFIP resolution (around 2021, with the X marker) the prefixes 20 and 27 are officially 'generic and non-binary' and assigned at random; embeds the DNI number
check: weights 5,4,3,2,7,6,5,4,3,2 over the 10 digits (prefix + DNI), r = sum mod 11, C = 11 - r; r = 0 gives 0; r = 1 (C would be 10): prefix changes and C is fixed: 20 -> 23 with C 9, 27 -> 23 with C 4, 24 -> 23 with C 3 (30 -> 33 with 9, 34 -> 33 with 3)
examples: 20-12345678-6 (es.wikipedia worked figures: sum 148, remainder 5; final digit computed) ; 20-05536168-2 (python-stdnum) ; 20-26756539-3 (python-stdnum) ; invalid: 20-26756539-2 (stdnum)
assigned: by ANSES, at birth registration together with the DNI for newborns, or on request; foreigners without DNI get a CUIL in the 60 million block (Disp. RENAPER 4678/2019)
from_until: CUIT from Resolución General DGI 2700/1987 and Ley 23.495 (1987); CUIL from Decreto 1108/1998 (both per es.wikipedia references, not fetched); random 20/27 prefixes from the ANSES-AFIP joint resolution (about 2021)
sources: https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clave_%C3%9Anica_de_Identificaci%C3%B3n_Tributaria ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/2.1/stdnum.ar.cuit ; https://www.argentina.gob.ar/node/268732 (joint resolution: 'carácter genérico y no binario de los prefijos (20 y 27) ... y su asignación aleatoria')
design_claims: CUIL: sex prefix: corrected: 20/27 followed sex for numbers assigned before the ANSES-AFIP joint resolution (about 2021); since then the prefixes are officially generic and assigned at random; 23 replaces either when the check would be 10 ; CUIL: weighted mod 11: confirmed (reference; weights 5432765432, with the prefix-23 rule for remainder 1)
notes: No official (ANSES/ARCA) publication of the check algorithm found; es.wikipedia cites RG DGI 2700/1987. The resolution number and date for random prefixes were not found (argentina.gob.ar names it only as 'Resolución Conjunta de la ANSES y la AFIP'). Own check verified: 20123456786 pass, 20055361682 pass, 20267565393 pass, 20267565392 fail. Generation: prefix from sex for assignment dates before about 2021, random 20/27 after; then apply the 23 rule

label: National Identity Document number
structure: up to 8 digits, no check digit, assigned in national sequence at first registration with RENAPER. Display NN.NNN.NNN (dots), electronic 7-8 digits (older numbers have fewer digits). Blocks: 60.000.000-69.999.999 reserved since 2019 for ANSES/AFIP CUIL and CUIT of foreigners without DNI (Disposición RENAPER 4678/2019); newborns from September 2023 numbered from 70.000.000 after 59.999.999 ran out; foreign residents, naturalised citizens and late registrations get a separate numbering (official page; foreign residents usually 90.000.000+, informal)
encodes: sequence (date of first registration, not strictly birth year); nothing else
check: none
examples: no check digit; no authority example ; 20.123.456 (python-stdnum format example)
assigned: at birth registration (newborns registered with the Registro Civil get the DNI number); people registered late or foreigners on first identification
safe_source: https://www.argentina.gob.ar/dni (from September 2023 newborn DNIs start at 70 million 'dado que los 60 millones fueron asignados en el año 2019 para CUIT y CUIL de extranjeros'); Disposición RENAPER 4678/2019 of 2019-12-06 (reported by eleconomista.com.ar, infonegocios.info; Boletín Oficial text not fetched)
from_until: DNI under Ley 17.671 (1968); earlier Libreta de Enrolamiento / Libreta Cívica numbers are still held by older people (not researched); 60-69 million block reserved from 2019-12-06; 70 million series from September 2023
sources: https://www.argentina.gob.ar/dni ; https://eleconomista.com.ar/actualidad/por-numeros-dni-saltaran-59999999-70-millones-partir-septiembre-n65920 ; https://www.diariodecuyo.com.ar/noticias/dni-hoy-se-arranca-con-70-millones-60978.html ; https://infonegocios.info/enfoque/los-bebes-clase-2025-ya-tienen-dni-con-70-millones-la-guia-definitiva-para-saber-cuanto-anos-tiene-una-persona-segun-su-documento ; https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Documento_Nacional_de_Identidad_(Argentina)
design_claims: DNI: birth year (sequential): confirmed as sequential by first registration (Infonegocios: assigned 'de manera correlativa' at first registration with RENAPER; not exactly the birth year) ; published issuance ranges by year: only one official anchor found: 59.999.999 exhausted and 70.000.000 started for newborns in September 2023 (argentina.gob.ar); no official year-by-number table; press articles (Infonegocios 2025, Tecnobits) give informal year tables, Tecnobits unreliable ; safe = a DNI above the series issued at the reference date: confirmed as workable, but a stronger option exists: corrected: the 60.000.000-69.999.999 block is reserved for foreigners' CUIL/CUIT, so a DNI there is never held as a DNI (it is someone's CUIL/CUIT body), and numbers above the 70 million series at the reference date are unissued; foreigners' 90 million series also exists, so 'above the series' must stay below 90.000.000
notes: Sequence anchors for series.tsv: only 2023-09 = 70.000.000 (newborns) is official; for earlier dates a demographic interpolation (cumulative births since 1968) would be a design choice, not a source. Separate numbering for foreigners and late registrations means the newborn sequence is not the only one. Non-binary X marker on DNI from Decreto 476/2021 (reported 2024-25 that the government plans to repeal it; status unverified)

label: Social insurance number
structure: LLL (Laufnummer, sequence, first digit not 0) + P (check digit) + DDMMYY (birth date). 10 digits, display 'LLLP DDMMYY'. When the exact day/month is unknown or all sequence numbers for a date are used, a fictitious date is used with month 13, 14 or 15.
encodes: date (birth day, month and two-digit year; no century, no sex)
check: P = (3*L1 + 7*L2 + 9*L3 + 5*D1 + 8*D2 + 4*M1 + 2*M2 + 1*Y1 + 6*Y2) mod 11; if the remainder is 10 the Laufnummer is skipped (next higher one used)
examples: 1237 010180 (born 1980-01-01; de.wikipedia example) ; no authority example found (the 2008 ministry answer gives the rule but no number)
assigned: at birth (reported via the civil register to the Dachverband der Sozialversicherungsträger) or at first contact with Austrian social insurance (employment, residence)
from_until: in use since the 1970s; unchanged
sources: https://www.parlament.gv.at/dokument/XXIII/AB/4690/fnameorig_136871.html (Anfragebeantwortung 4690/AB XXIII. GP, BMGFJ, 2008-09-01: structure, weights, remainder-10 rule, months 13-15) ; https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sozialversicherungsnummer ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/stdnum.at.vnr
design_claims: date; weighted mod 11; wrong check: confirmed
notes: Example verified with a script: 1237010180 passes, 1236010180 fails. A real-looking generator should occasionally emit months 13-15 only if modelling unknown dates; safe mode must NOT use months 13-15 as an 'impossible date', because they are real fictitious-date numbers. Because remainder 10 is skipped rather than mapped, a wrong check digit of the form 'remainder + k' is always invalid for that Laufnummer. No test range found.

label: Tax file number
structure: NNNNNNNN (8 digits) + C (check), 9 digits for individuals; 8-digit TFNs were issued to non-individuals (Wikipedia). Display NNN NNN NNN, electronic 9 digits
encodes: nothing
check: weighted mod 11 (whole-number test): digits 1-9 times 1,4,3,7,5,8,6,9,10; valid when the sum is divisible by 11 (the check digit has weight 10, so some 8-digit bodies have no valid check digit)
examples: 123 456 782 (Wikipedia worked example: weighted sum 253 = 11 x 23; also python-stdnum) ; invalid: 999 999 999 (stdnum). No ATO example found
assigned: on application to the ATO, at any age (not at birth); enhanced TFN scheme legislated 1988
from_until: TFNs since the 1930s; current scheme from 1988; 9 digits for individuals
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tax_file_number (algorithm tagged citation needed) ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/2.1/stdnum.au.tfn ; https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/payg-withholding/payments-you-need-to-withhold-from/payments-to-employees/tax-file-number-and-withholding-declarations (code numbers; 403 to scripts, read via search quotes)
design_claims: encodes nothing: confirmed (Wikipedia: 9-digit TFNs have no embedded meaning) ; weighted mod 11: confirmed (reference: Wikipedia worked example + stdnum; the ATO gives the algorithm only to registered software developers, no public ATO text found) ; safe = wrong check: confirmed; the ATO's published placeholder code numbers (000 000 000 not provided, 111 111 111 not valid/applied, 333 333 333 under-18, 444 444 444 pensioner, investment codes such as 444 444 441) are reserved but are not 'numbers nobody holds' in the useful sense — all except 000 000 000 fail the check, and 000 000 000 passes it
notes: Own check: 123456782 pass, 999999999 fail; 000000000 passes the arithmetic (avoid it as a realistic draw); 111111111, 333333333, 444444444 fail. When drawing, pick the 8-digit body and the check digit 0-9 that makes the sum divisible by 11; redraw if none exists. python-stdnum applies the first 8 weights to 8-digit TFNs; the correct 8-digit rule was not confirmed (out of scope: those are non-individuals)

label: unique master number
structure: DD (day) + MM (month) + GGG (last three digits of birth year: 9xx = 19xx, 0xx = 20xx) + RR (registration area) + BBB (serial for people born the same day: 000-499 male, 500-999 female) + K (check). 13 digits, one block
encodes: date, sex, century (3-digit year), place (register of the place of birth-register entry; for citizens born abroad, the parents' last residence in BiH)
check: modulo 11 (the law names the method only). Algorithm as in the Slovenian Uredba 1999 and sr.wikipedia: weights 7 6 5 4 3 2 7 6 5 4 3 2 on digits 1-12; r = sum mod 11; K = 11 - r; r = 0 gives K = 0; r = 1 is never assigned (serial skipped) (law art. 7: 'kompjuterski modul 11 prema uputstvu MCP')
examples: 2902932505526 (Slovenian Uredba 1999 worked example, RR 50: algorithm only) ; 0101006500006 (en.wikipedia, RR 50: algorithm only)
assigned: ex officio at entry in the birth register in BiH, within 15 days (art. 8-9); citizens born abroad on request via consulates (art. 10)
place_codes: Zakon o jedinstvenom maticnom broju BiH (Sl. glasnik BiH 32/01, 63/08, 103/11, 87/13, 84/15) art. 5, current list: RS 11 (Banja Luka, Prijedor, Gradiska...), 12 (Bijeljina, Doboj, Brod...), 13 (Trebinje, Foca, Zvornik, Istocno Sarajevo...); 14 Brcko Distrikt; FBiH 15 (Mostar, Konjic, Siroki Brijeg...), 16 (Bihac, Livno, Cazin...), 17 (Sarajevo municipalities, Gorazde), 18 (Tuzla, Gradacac, Orasje...), 19 (Zenica, Travnik, Bugojno...). 9 codes. Art. 5a: numbers issued under the older SFRJ areas (10 Banja Luka, 11 Bihac, 12 Doboj, 13 Gorazde, 14 Livno, 15 Mostar, 16 Prijedor, 17 Sarajevo, 18 Tuzla, 19 Zenica) are not changed. Statute text; no Wikidata property found
from_until: JMBG from 1977 (SFRJ); BiH law 2001; the RR list was redrawn after the Constitutional Court suspended art. 5 (U 3/11, newborns without JMB in 2013) and replaced by amendment 87/2013 (my reading, the integral text does not date art. 5; 84/2015 possible); older numbers keep the SFRJ-era meaning of 10-19
sources: https://advokat-prnjavorac.com:8443/zakoni/Zakon-o-JMB-BiH.pdf (integral text: art. 4, 5, 5a, 7, 8-10, 33) ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unique_Master_Citizen_Number (SFRJ-era codes) ; https://sr.wikipedia.org/sr-el/Jedinstveni_mati%C4%8Dni_broj_gra%C4%91ana
design_claims: encodes date, sex, region: confirmed ; RR per republic: corrected: BiH's current codes (art. 5) are 11-19 with new areas (11-13 Republika Srpska, 14 Brcko, 15-19 Federation), and 10 is no longer assigned; Wikipedia's 10 Banja Luka ... 19 Zenica table is the SFRJ-era meaning, still valid for older numbers ; mod 11: confirmed (law art. 7 names modulo 11; weights at reference level) ; 10/11 case as SI (r = 1 never assigned) ; safe = wrong check: confirmed
notes: No authority-published worked example with this country code found. The algorithm is the shared SFRJ one; the Slovenian Uredba example 2902932505526 and 0101006500006 (RR 50) verify it. The integral text is a lawyer's consolidation (advokat-prnjavorac.com) of the official gazette texts; the official IDDEEA site hosts only the amendments. Generator: use the current 11-19 map for births after the 2013 change and the SFRJ map before. Foreigners get RR 01 (art. 33), out of scope. Same JMB for life; residence changes do not change it (art. 16).

label: National Register number (identification number)
native_label: numéro de registre national / rijksregisternummer (numéro d'identification)
structure: YYMMDD (birth date, year-month-day) + NNN (numéro d'ordre: 001-997 odd for men, 002-998 even for women, in order of registration) + KK (check). Display YY.MM.DD-NNN.KK (e.g. 42.01.22.051-81); electronic 11 digits. Unknown day/month: 00 (e.g. 40 00 00 955); when such a series is exhausted the day becomes 01, 02, ...; fully unknown date: fictitious 01 00 1900 / 01 00 2000. No century digit in the number.
encodes: date, sex (numéro d'ordre parity); century only through the check computation
check: KK = 97 - (YYMMDDNNN mod 97); for people born from 2000-01-01 the 9 digits are prefixed with 2 (i.e. 2YYMMDDNNN) before the mod 97
examples: 42.01.22.051-81 (man born 1942-01-22; Registre national TI000 instruction) ; 40 00 01 001-33 (born 1940, unknown month and day, series overflow onto day 01; TI000)
assigned: automatically at first registration in the National Register (birth registration for people born in Belgium, or entry in the population/foreigners register)
from_until: National Register number since the 1968 register; royal decree for 2000+: sequence restarts at 001/002 for births from 2000-01-01, the check uses the '2' prefix, and cancelled numbers are never reused; structure stays 11 digits
sources: https://www.rijksregister.fgov.be/sites/default/files/documents/fr/registre-national/instructions/liste-TI/TI000_Numero-identification.pdf ; https://www.ibz.rrn.fgov.be/sites/default/files/documents/fr/registre-national/fichier-rn/fichier-RN.pdf ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/stdnum.be.nn
design_claims: date, sex; 97 - mod 97 (prefix 2 from 2000); wrong check: confirmed
notes: Examples verified with a script: 420122051 -> 81 pass; 400001001 -> 33 pass; the TI000 example '40 00 00 955-81' computes to 79, so either a typo in the instruction or a text-extraction issue (not used). Unknown-date numbers (month/day 00) exist and are valid; 1.0 can ignore them. BIS numbers (month + 20 or + 40 for non-residents) are out of scope. No published test range found. The number is also printed in the eID MRZ optional field (design 5.1).

label: uniform civil number
structure: YYMMDD (birth date; month as is for 1900-1999, + 20 for births before 1900, + 40 for 2000-2099) + RRS (digits 7-9: a number in the birth district's range, 000-999; digit 9 even = male, odd = female) + C (check). 10 digits, one block
encodes: date, century (month offset), sex, place (district of birth, by range of digits 7-9)
check: weights 2 4 8 5 10 9 7 3 6 on digits 1-9; r = sum mod 11; C = r, and r = 10 gives C = 0
examples: 0847038794 (female born 2008-07-03; bg.wikipedia, stated to belong to no real person) ; 0011113966 (male born 1900-11-11, Pleven range 396-435; bg.wikipedia) ; 1012191435 (female born 1910-12-19, Veliko Tarnovo range 140-169; bg.wikipedia) ; invalid date: 8019010008 (python-stdnum)
assigned: at birth registration (ESGRAON / GD GRAO); existing residents were numbered in November 1977
place_codes: 28 former districts (okrazi) of 1977 plus 926-999 'other/unknown': Blagoevgrad 000-043, Burgas 044-093, Varna 094-139, Veliko Tarnovo 140-169, Vidin 170-183, Vratsa 184-217, Gabrovo 218-233, Kardzhali 234-281, Kyustendil 282-301, Lovech 302-319, Montana 320-341, Pazardzhik 342-377, Pernik 378-395, Pleven 396-435, Plovdiv 436-501, Razgrad 502-527, Ruse 528-555, Silistra 556-575, Sliven 576-601, Smolyan 602-623, Sofia city 624-721, Sofia district 722-751, Stara Zagora 752-789, Dobrich 790-821, Targovishte 822-843, Haskovo 844-871, Shumen 872-903, Yambol 904-925, other/unknown 926-999. Published on bg.wikipedia (CC BY-SA) and en.wikipedia; no official GRAO list found; no Wikidata property found
from_until: since 1977 (ESGRAON); format unchanged; whether the district ranges are still applied to recent births was not confirmed
sources: https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%95%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%BD_%D0%B3%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B6%D0%B4%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8_%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%B5%D1%80 ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unique_citizenship_number ; https://kik-info.com/spravochnik/proverka-na-egn.php ; python-stdnum stdnum/bg/egn.py
design_claims: encodes date, sex, century (month offset), region: confirmed (region = district of birth, as ranges of digits 7-9) ; weighted mod 11: confirmed (weights 2 4 8 5 10 9 7 3 6, r = 10 -> 0) ; safe = wrong check: confirmed
notes: Examples verified with own script: 0847038794, 0011113966, 1012191435 pass; stdnum 8032056031, 7523169263, 7542011030 also pass. No issuer-level (GRAO or regulation) text found; bg.wikipedia, en.wikipedia, kik-info and python-stdnum agree. One third-party guide (lookuptax.com) has the sex parity reversed: wrong, the worked examples show even = male. Foreigners get an LNCh (ЛНЧ), a different number, out of scope. The 'jmbg'-like district table is the 1977 okrug division, so birthplaces must map from modern oblasts (28 oblasts now, mostly the same names; Montana = former Mihaylovgrad, Dobrich = Tolbukhin).

label: Individual Taxpayer Registry number
structure: NNNNNNNN (8 digits, sequence) + R (ninth digit, fiscal region of the address at first registration) + C1 C2 (two mod 11 check digits). Display NNN.NNN.NNR-CC, electronic 11 digits. Ninth digit (Receita Federal): 1 DF, GO, MT, MS, TO; 2 PA, AM, AC, AP, RO, RR; 3 CE, MA, PI; 4 PE, RN, PB, AL; 5 BA, SE; 6 MG; 7 RJ, ES; 8 SP; 9 PR, SC; 0 RS
encodes: place (fiscal region of the address given at first registration — not birth, not current residence) via the ninth digit; otherwise sequence
check: two mod 11 digits: C1 = weights 10,9,...,2 over digits 1-9, r = sum mod 11, C1 = 0 if r < 2 else 11 - r; C2 = weights 11,10,...,2 over digits 1-9 and C1, same reduction (equivalently (10 x sum) mod 11 mod 10)
examples: 123.456.789-09 (pt.wikipedia worked example: sums 210 and 244) ; 390.533.447-05 (python-stdnum) ; 111.444.777-35 (common worked example, not official) ; invalid: 231.002.999-00 (stdnum)
example_source: https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadastro_de_Pessoas_F%C3%ADsicas ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/2.1/stdnum.br.cpf ; region example XXX.XXX.XX8-XX for São Paulo in the Receita leaflet
assigned: on registration with the Receita Federal (at any age); since 2015-12-01 issued with the birth certificate at civil registration (Receita news release of 2015-12-01, cited by pt.wikipedia)
place_codes: 10 fiscal regions (ninth digit), published by the Receita Federal leaflet 'cadastros-dig.pdf' (gov.br, Brazilian government work); state membership listed above; no Wikidata property needed
from_until: Registro das Pessoas Físicas from Lei 4.862 of 1965-11-29; CPF from Decreto-Lei 401 of 1968-12-30; same 11-digit format since
sources: https://www.gov.br/receitafederal/pt-br/assuntos/educacao-fiscal/educacao_fiscal/folhetos-orientativos/cadastros-dig.pdf (ninth digit, issuer) ; https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadastro_de_Pessoas_F%C3%ADsicas (check rule, uncited) ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/2.1/stdnum.br.cpf
design_claims: ninth digit = fiscal region: confirmed (issuer: Receita Federal leaflet 'O nono dígito do seu CPF corresponde à Região Fiscal do endereço informado no cadastramento inicial', with the 10-region table) ; two mod 11: confirmed (reference: pt.wikipedia + python-stdnum; no Receita publication of the algorithm found) ; safe = wrong check: confirmed (dense space)
notes: Evidence 'issuer' for the region digit, 'reference' for the check rule. Region is that of the address at first registration: for a person registered at birth since 2015 it is the birth-registration state; for older people it may differ from birth state. Validators commonly reject repdigits (000.000.000-00 ... 999.999.999-99), which pass the arithmetic: avoid them. Own check: 12345678909 pass, 01234567890 pass, 39053344705 pass, 11144477735 pass, 23100299900 fail

label: Social Insurance Number
native_label: Social Insurance Number (SIN) / numéro d'assurance sociale (NAS)
structure: R (first digit, region of registration) + NNNNNNN (7 digits) + C (Luhn check). Display NNN NNN NNN (also NNN-NNN-NNN), electronic 9 digits. First digit (Wikipedia, uncited): 1 Atlantic provinces (NS, NB, PE, NL; new Ontario numbers now also in the 1 series), 2-3 Quebec, 4-5 Ontario (except north-western Ontario) and overseas forces, 6 north-western Ontario, MB, SK, AB, NT, NU, 7 BC and YT, 9 temporary residents (law: SOR/2013-82 s. 8), 8 business numbers (BN), 0 CRA-assigned individual/temporary/adoption tax numbers
encodes: place (region of first registration, approximate; not birth) via the first digit; 9 = not a citizen or permanent resident; otherwise sequence/nothing
check: Luhn over all 9 digits
examples: no authority worked example found ; 046 454 286 (Wikipedia, called fictitious; region 0) ; 123-456-782 (python-stdnum doctest) ; invalid: 999-999-999 (bad check, stdnum)
assigned: on application to Service Canada (since 1964); numbers for newborns can be requested with the provincial birth registration (Newborn Registration Service — not re-verified this session)
place_codes: first-digit region table only, 9 values; published on Wikipedia without a citation; no official table found; no Wikidata property
from_until: from 1964; 9-series rules in Social Insurance Number Regulations SOR/2013-82 (from 2013); plastic cards replaced by a confirmation letter 2014-03-31
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Social_insurance_number ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/2.1/stdnum.ca.sin ; https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/regulations/SOR-2013-82/FullText.html (s. 8: numbers for non-citizens/non-PRs 'must begin with the number 9') ; https://lists.arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum-users/2023/msg00000.html
design_claims: encodes province of registration (first digit): confirmed at reference level only (Wikipedia, uncited; no ESDC table found), and it is approximate: Wikipedia says regions have been supplied with other regions' series and new Ontario numbers now start with 1 ; Luhn: confirmed (reference) ; safe = an unissued first digit (survey): corrected: no first digit is officially reserved. 8 is used for business numbers and 0 for CRA individual tax numbers (Wikipedia); python-stdnum rejects 0 and 8 as SIN prefixes but cites no source. A 0- or 8-prefixed number is not a SIN but may be someone's BN or tax number, so use wrong_check (or, if the owner accepts reference-level evidence, first digit 8 as unissued_series with that caveat)
notes: 0-, 8- prefixed numbers can pass Luhn (823456785 passes Luhn; stdnum rejects it as InvalidComponent). 9-series numbers expire (SOR/2013-82 s. 9) and are replaced by a new number when the holder becomes a citizen or PR (s. 13), so a 9 number for a citizen is inconsistent. Region from the first digit should be drawn from the person's province with low confidence; consider not encoding it. Examples verified with own Luhn: 046454286 pass, 123456782 pass, 999999999 fail

label: AHV/AVS number (social security number, AHVN13)
structure: 756 (ISO 3166-1 numeric code of Switzerland) + 9 random digits + 1 check digit; 13 digits, display 756.XXXX.XXXX.XC
encodes: nothing (prefix 756)
check: EAN-13 / GTIN check digit over the first 12 digits (weights 1,3,1,3,... from the left; check = (10 - sum mod 10) mod 10)
examples: 756.9217.0769.85 (de.wikipedia via de-academic) ; 756.1234.5678.97 (widely used non-official example)
assigned: automatically at birth registration or on immigration/first employment (via the civil register Infostar or ZAS); also on request by employers, schools or health insurers
from_until: AHVN13 since 2008-07-01, replacing the 11-digit AHVN11 that encoded name and birth date (AHVN11 no longer in use)
sources: https://www.bsv.admin.ch/de/ahv-nummer (BSV: 13 digits, fully anonymous and random, starts with 756; check digit shown only in an image) ; https://docs-dr.trellix.com/data-and-email/docs/swiss-social-security-number-ahv ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/stdnum.ch.ssn
design_claims: nothing (prefix 756); GTIN check; wrong check: confirmed (EAN-13 at reference level; BSV confirms 756 + random 13 digits)
notes: Examples verified with a script: 7569217076985 and 7561234567897 pass EAN-13; 7569217076986 fails. No official test range found (a third-party tool states there is none). ZAS's own structure page was not reached; reading the BSV image or ZAS documentation by hand would raise the check rule to issuer.

label: Unique National Role
structure: N{7,8} (correlative number, no fixed width) + DV (check: 0-9 or K). Display NN.NNN.NNN-D (dots and hyphen), electronic digits + DV (K upper case). Since 1984 assigned in correlative order; numbers below about 12 million do not follow age
encodes: sequence (since 1984 at birth registration, so roughly birth date); nothing else
check: mod 11: digits from the right times 2,3,4,5,6,7,2,3,..., s = sum, v = 11 - (s mod 11); v = 11 -> 0, v = 10 -> K, else v
examples: 12.345.678-5 (T13 news worked example, notes the widely shared -0 is wrong) ; 12.531.909-2 (python-stdnum) ; 76.086.428-5 (python-stdnum; a company RUT, 76 million range) ; invalid: 12.531.909-3 (stdnum)
assigned: at birth registration by the Servicio de Registro Civil e Identificación (since 1984 correlative); earlier holders got it with the identity card or passport; foreigners with a residence visa on registration
from_until: identity number from 1930 starting at 1 (Registro Civil presentation at ICAO MRTD 2014, via search snippet); RUN on identity cards in Santiago from July 1970; RUN established by decreto 18 of 1973-03-13, issued from 1973-07-01; correlative at birth from 1984 (es.wikipedia). Pre-1984 numbers (below about 12 million) are held by living people
sources: https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rol_%C3%9Anico_Nacional ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unique_National_Role ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/2.1/stdnum.cl.rut ; https://www.chileatiende.gob.cl/fichas/3394 ; https://registrosocial.gob.cl/docs/RUN_y_enrolamiento.pdf (not reachable; search summary: Chilean RUNs issued sequentially, 'in the 28 million range', undated)
design_claims: RUN encodes birth year (sequential): confirmed for births registered since 1984 (es.wikipedia: 'Desde 1984 el RUN se otorga siguiendo un orden correlativo'; below 12 million not correlated with age) ; mod 11 with K: confirmed (reference: stdnum + Wikipedia + press; no SII/Registro Civil text of the algorithm found) ; published issuance ranges by year: corrected: none found; only informal points: 'below 12 million' = pre-1984 and an undated Registro Civil document saying the series is 'in the 28 million range'; no dated anchors, so series.tsv anchors for CL would have to be derived (e.g. cumulative registered births), not sourced ; safe = a RUN above the series issued: unconfirmed (workable in principle, but the current top is not published; companies' RUTs from SII occupy 50-99 million ranges such as 76.xxx.xxx, so 'above the series' must stay well below 50 million)
notes: RUN = RUT for natural persons; legal persons get RUTs from SII in high ranges (76 million example). Own check verified: 12345678-5, 12531909-2, 76086428-5 pass; 12531909-3 fails. Unverified hint: provisional identifiers for migrants/students (e.g. IPE, provisional RUN) are said to start at 100 million — not checked. Choose an unissued RUN between the estimated current top (about 28-29 million in 2025?) and 50 million, with that caveat, or fall back to wrong_check ; [merge 2026-11-04] safe_method set to wrong_check: no current series top is published.

label: Resident identity number
structure: AAAAAA (6-digit administrative division code, GB/T 2260, county level, where the number was first compiled) + YYYYMMDD (birth date, 4-digit year) + NNN (sequence code, odd = male, even = female) + C (check, 0-9 or X); 18 characters, no separators in display or electronic form. Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan residents (residence-permit holders) use 810000, 820000, 830000. Older first-generation numbers (from 1984) were 15 digits: AAAAAA + YYMMDD + NNN, no check; upgraded to 18 by inserting 19 and adding the check
encodes: place (county of household registration when the number was compiled; does not change when boundaries change or the person moves), date, sex (sequence parity), century (4-digit year)
check: ISO 7064 MOD 11-2: weights 7 9 10 5 8 4 2 1 6 3 7 9 10 5 8 4 2 on the 17 body digits (2^(18-i) mod 11); S mod 11 = r; check = (12 - r) mod 11, 10 written as X; equivalently table r 0..10 -> 1 0 X 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2
examples: 11010519491231002X (Beijing Chaoyang 110105, born 1949-12-31, sequence 002 = female, check X) ; 440524188001010014 (Guangdong Shantou 440524, born 1880-01-01, sequence 001 = male, check 4) ; 11010219840406970X (zh.wikipedia example: Beijing Xicheng, 1984-04-06, female)
example_source: GB 11643-1999 appendix (公民身份号码实例), scanned at https://zjw.beijing.gov.cn/Portals/0/zhuanti/fazhan/%E8%BA%AB%E4%BB%BD%E8%AF%81GB11643-1999.pdf (scan not text-readable here; the two numbers are the ones widely quoted from it, e.g. https://cloud.tencent.com/developer/article/1114323) ; https://zh.wikipedia.org/zh-cn/中华人民共和国公民身份号码
assigned: at birth registration (从出生登记之日起编定), by the local public-security station; HK/MO/TW residents when they apply for a residence permit (2018 on)
place_codes: GB/T 2260 county-level codes, published by the Ministry of Civil Affairs (行政区划代码, mca.gov.cn, yearly list; government data, no explicit licence). About 2,850 current county units; numbers keep historic codes of abolished or renamed counties, so the table needs historic codes too. Wikidata: P13971 (China division code by MCA, 6-digit, e.g. 350100): 39,376 items, 15,765 with a GeoNames ID (P1566) as of 2026-11-04. P442 is the NBS statistics code with spaces (e.g. '35 01'), not the 6-digit MCA code
from_until: 18-digit form from 1999-10-01 (GB 11643-1999, State Council decision); 15-digit first-generation numbers from 1984, upgraded (all first-generation cards expired by 2013)
sources: GB 11643-1999 (national standard; scan above) ; https://zh.wikipedia.org/zh-cn/中华人民共和国公民身份号码 ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/stdnum.cn.ric
design_claims: encodes region of registration, date, sex: confirmed ; ISO 7064 MOD 11-2: confirmed ; safe = wrong check: confirmed (no reserved range found) ; place data via P442: corrected: the 6-digit GB/T 2260 code is P13971 (China division code by MCA); P442 is the NBS statistics code
notes: All three examples pass my own MOD 11-2 code. The address code is the county where the number was compiled, usually but not always the birthplace (place_source = registration). Foreigners' permanent-residence numbers (2023 on, 18 characters starting with 9) are out of scope. Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan codes 81/82/83 are province level only.

label: birth number
structure: YYMMDD (birth date; MM = month for men, month + 50 for women; when a day's serials run out, an extra series uses month + 20 for men and + 70 for women) + NNN or NNNC. 10 digits for people born from 1954-01-01 (YY 54-99 = 19YY, YY 00-53 = 20YY); 9 digits (3-digit suffix, no check) for people born before 1954. Display form YYMMDD/NNNN (slash), electronic form 10 (or 9) digits
encodes: date, sex, century (by length and YY)
check: the whole 10-digit number is divisible by 11 (C = first 9 digits mod 11). Exception: when the first 9 digits mod 11 = 10, C = 0 (so the number is not divisible by 11); used for about a thousand numbers and ended by FSU directive c. Vk. 2898/1985. 9-digit numbers have no check
examples: 710319/2745 (male born 1971-03-19; python-stdnum doctest) ; 736028/5163 (female born 1973-10-28; cs.wikipedia worked example) ; invalid: 7103192746 (wrong check)
assigned: at birth registration (the Ministry of the Interior determines it, zakon 133/2000 Sb. par. 13 odst. 2); foreigners with permanent residence also get one
from_until: rodné číslo since 1947 (Czechoslovakia; current form from vyhlaska 55/1976 Zb.); 9-digit numbers for births before 1954, 10-digit from 1954; +20/+70 extra series from zakon 53/2004 Sb. (2004); remainder-10 exception until 1985. Numbers assigned in Slovakia before 1993-01-01 are also valid CZ numbers (par. 13 odst. 8)
sources: https://www.zakonyprolidi.cz/cs/2000-133 (par. 13 odst. 3-5: structure, +50, divisible by 11, 9-digit before 1954, +20/+70) ; https://mv.gov.cz/clanek/prideleni-rodneho-cisla.aspx ; https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rodn%C3%A9_%C4%8D%C3%ADslo (remainder-10 exception)
design_claims: encodes date, sex (month + 50): confirmed, plus century from length/YY ; +20 (men) / +70 (women) extra series from 2004: confirmed (par. 13 odst. 5, zakon 53/2004 Sb.) ; pre-1954 9-digit numbers: confirmed ; divisible by 11: confirmed ; remainder-10 exception: confirmed at reference level (cs.wikipedia + python-stdnum, which accepts first-9 mod 11 mod 10 for all years) ; safe = wrong check: confirmed
notes: Examples verified with own script: 7103192745 and 7360285163 pass (divisible by 11), 7103192746 fails. No authority-published worked example found. Generator: produce only numbers divisible by 11 (never the remainder-10 form) and use +20/+70 rarely (only when a day's series is exhausted, i.e. a tiny share of post-2004 births). Change of number on sex change (par. 17 odst. 2 d)), so sex in the number follows current sex. Long-running plan (since 2010) to replace it with a meaningless identifier; no date set. 9-digit range: 1900-1953 (stdnum also maps 9-digit YY 80-99 to 18YY).

label: Tax identification number
structure: 11 digits: D1..D10 + P (check digit). No leading zero except for test numbers. In D1..D10 exactly one digit occurs twice or three times, every other digit at most once; if a digit occurs three times, the three may not all be on directly consecutive positions (two adjacent are allowed: ITZ Bund example 65929970489 has '99'). Until early 2014 no real IdNr started with 0, 1, 2 or 3; leading 1, 2, 3 issued from 2014. Display often 'NN NNN NNN NNN'.
encodes: nothing
check: ISO 7064 MOD 11,10 (ELSTER calcPruefzifferSteuerID: product = 10; for each of the 10 digits: sum = (digit + product) mod 10, 0 -> 10; product = 2*sum mod 11; check = 11 - product, 10 -> 0)
examples: 02476291358 (ELSTER test IdNr, digit 2 doubled) ; 86095742719, 47036892816, 65929970489 (digit 9 three times), 57549285017, 25768131411 (IdNr from the ITZ Bund concept, 'for illustration only, never to be used for test or live transmissions')
assigned: by the BZSt at birth registration (registration office reports the birth), or on first registration of residence; issued to all residents from 2007-2008
safe_source: https://download.elster.de/download/schnittstellen/Pruefung_der_Steuer_und_Steueridentifikatsnummer.pdf ('Keine führenden Nullen erlaubt, außer es ist eine Testidentifikationsnummer'; ERiC exposes a Test-IdNr check, see ERiC-Entwicklerhandbuch)
from_until: IdNr since 2007 (§ 139b AO); digit-repeat rule: exactly one digit twice or three times (three-times form is the current rule; older documents only allowed exactly twice); leading 1-3 from 2014
sources: https://download.elster.de/download/schnittstellen/Pruefung_der_Steuer_und_Steueridentifikatsnummer.pdf ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/stdnum.de.idnr
design_claims: ISO 7064 MOD 11,10 and the digit-repeat rule: confirmed, with the exact rule: exactly one digit occurs twice or three times in D1..D10, and a tripled digit may not have all three occurrences consecutive ; ELSTER test numbers: confirmed: ELSTER's spec says test IdNr are the only ones allowed a leading zero (example 02476291358), so safe mode = leading 0 + digit rule + valid check (a reserved range, not a list) ; Steuer-ID encodes nothing: confirmed
notes: Examples verified with a script: all six pass MOD 11,10; 02476291359 fails. The ITZ Bund example 65929970489 shows that two of three equal digits may be adjacent, so the builder must forbid only three-in-a-row. DE passport (design 5.1, survey claim): confirmed: § 4 Abs. 2 Nr. 5 PassG says the Reisepass serial number consists of the Behördenkennzahl of the passport authority plus a randomly assigned passport number that may contain letters (https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/pa_g_1986/__4.html); § 2 PAuswG says the same for the Personalausweis (4-character authority code + 5 random characters). No public list of Behördenkennzahlen was found, so places.tsv cannot be filled from an official source; the character set (digits 1-9 and selected consonants) is from a consumer FAQ only.

label: CPR number (personal identification number)
structure: DDMMYY (birth date) + '-' + SSSS (løbenummer: first digit with YY gives the century; last digit odd = male, even = female). Display DDMMYY-SSSS; electronic 10 digits. Century from digit 7 and YY: 0-3 -> 1900-1999; 4 or 9 -> 2000-2036 if YY 00-36, else 1937-1999; 5-8 -> 2000-2057 if YY 00-57, else 1858-1899.
encodes: date, sex, century (digit 7 with year)
check: historically modulus 11 over all 10 digits with weights 4,3,2,7,6,5,4,3,2,1 (sum divisible by 11; serials giving remainder 1 skipped). Since 1 October 2007 numbers without a valid modulus 11 are issued for dates whose series ran out, so modulus 11 is no longer a validity test; CPR advises systems to accept such numbers.
examples: 211062-5629 (man born 1862-10-21; digit 7 = 5 with YY 62 -> 1800s; modulus 11 sum 110; cited on da.wikipedia worked example) ; no second authority-published example found (cpr.dk 'Personnummeret i CPR' PDF returns 403 to scripts)
assigned: at birth registration (or on taking up residence); CPR register since 2 April 1968 (Greenland 1 May 1972)
from_until: CPR number from 1968-04-02; modulus 11 guaranteed only for numbers issued before 2007-10-01; numbers without modulus 11 from 2007-10-01 (per da.wikipedia, so far only for birth dates 1 January); new number on legal gender change since 2014-09-01
sources: https://www.dst.dk/da/Statistik/dokumentation/Times/cpr-oplysninger/bef-personnummer/pnr ; https://da.wikipedia.org/wiki/CPR-nummer ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Personal_identification_number_(Denmark) ; https://admin.cpr.dk/media/12066/personnummeret-i-cpr.pdf (official, 403 to automated fetch, not read)
design_claims: no check digit since 2007: corrected: modulus 11 still holds for all numbers issued before 2007-10-01 and for most later ones; from 2007-10-01 CPR also issues numbers that fail modulus 11 (for dates whose series are exhausted), so modulus 11 cannot be relied on, but generated numbers should normally still satisfy it to look realistic ; safe method an impossible date: confirmed as the best available ; does CPR publish test numbers or a reserved range: no public range found. Fictitious test CPR numbers are handed out by Digitaliseringsstyrelsen's Fællesoffentlige Testdatasæt under an agreement (not public) and are checked daily against the CPR register, which means they are ordinary-format numbers with no reserved range
notes: Impossible date: e.g. day + 60 or month 13+. Statens Administration's payroll guide on 'fiktive CPR numre' says that, following CPR guidance, fictitious numbers add 60 to the day (born the 22nd -> 82); so day + 60 is a recognised 'not a real person' convention, though not a CPR-published test range (https://statens-adm.dk/media/2kadh0n3/fiktive-cpr-numre.pdf, text partly garbled). The test-data pointer is from Mastercard Payment Services' Betalingsservice dummy-data note (https://partner.mastercardpaymentservices.com/media/feuaawdp/bs_dummy_data_til_brug_ved_test.pdf), a third-party source, so evidence for the Digst dataset is single. Example check: 2110625629 passes modulus 11, 2110625628 fails. Real numbers circulate on Wikipedia (111111-1118); not used. cpr.dk's own PDF should be read by hand to raise evidence to issuer.

label: Identity card number
structure: PP (province code of first registration: 01-24, 30 = Ecuadorians registered abroad) + T (third digit, 0-5 for natural persons) + NNNNNN (sequence) + C (mod 10 check). Display NNNNNNNNN-C or 10 digits, electronic 10 digits. Province codes: 01 Azuay ... 09 Guayas ... 17 Pichincha ... 20 Galápagos, 21 Sucumbíos, 22 Orellana, 23 Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas, 24 Santa Elena; 30 'Exterior' from Resolución 140 of the Registro Civil (Registro Oficial 681, 2012-04-12)
encodes: place (province where the person was first registered / the cédula first issued, not necessarily birth); otherwise sequence
check: mod 10 with alternating coefficients 2,1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2 on digits 1-9; products of 10 or more minus 9; C = (10 - sum mod 10) mod 10
examples: 0903686962 (ESPOL programming exam 2018: province 09 Guayas, check 2) ; 1714307103 (python-stdnum: province 17 Pichincha) ; invalid: 1714307104 (stdnum)
assigned: at birth registration with the Dirección General de Registro Civil, Identificación y Cedulación (number on the birth record) or at first cedulation — not verified this session
place_codes: 24 provinces + 30 (abroad); list on ecuadorlegalonline.com and es.wikipedia (secondary); code 30 by Registro Civil Resolución 140 (RO 681, 2012-04-12); provinces created later (20-24) postdate older holders' numbers; Wikidata: not checked
from_until: 10-digit cédula with province prefix for decades (start date not found); code 30 from 2012-04-12
sources: https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/2.1/stdnum.ec.ci ; https://www.dspace.espol.edu.ec/retrieve/a7b1cadb-669a-4116-a494-53982eafd9b8/EXA-2018-3S-FUNDAMENTOS%20DE%20PROGRAMACI%c3%93N-1-1Par.pdf ; https://www.ecuadorlegalonline.com/consultas/registro-civil/codigos-provincia-cedula-identidad ; https://esacc.corteconstitucional.gob.ec/storage/api/v1/10_DWL_FL/e2NhcnBldGE6J2VzY3JpdG8nLCB1dWlkOicxODMyYTNhZC1hMzRiLTQ0MTUtYTNhYi0wNmEwMWYwYTdhZmQucGRmJ30= (Resolución 140, code 30)
design_claims: encodes province: confirmed (reference), and it is the province of first registration, with 30 for registrations abroad ; mod 10 (2-1 weights): confirmed (reference: stdnum + ESPOL; no Registro Civil publication of the algorithm found)
notes: Own check verified: 0903686962 pass, 1714307103 pass, 1714307104 fail. A public letter reported validators that rejected prefix 30 because of the province range check: generate 30 only for people registered abroad. Third digit 6 and 9 are RUC types for public and private entities (not persons). Unassigned province codes (25-29, 00) would be an unassigned_place option, but no source says they are reserved

label: Personal identification code
structure: G (sex and century: 1/2 = male/female born 1800-1899, 3/4 1900-1999, 5/6 2000-2099, 7/8 2100-2199) + YYMMDD (birth date) + SSS (serial for people born the same day) + C (check digit). 11 digits, no separator.
encodes: date, sex, century; before 2013 the serial range informally indicated the birth hospital/area (no official list)
check: weights 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,1 over the first 10 digits, r = sum mod 11; if r < 10, C = r; if r = 10, repeat with weights 3,4,5,6,7,8,9,1,2,3; if again 10, C = 0 (EVS 585:2007)
examples: 37605030299 (man born 1976-05-03; first-pass sum 108, remainder 9) ; 34501234215 (man born 1945-01-23, Pärnu) ; 49403136515 / 49403136526 (girl born 1994-03-13, Põlva) — all from et.wikipedia
assigned: at birth registration (healthcare provider requests the code from the population register); on first entry in the population register for others
from_until: standard EV ST 585:1990, current EVS 585:2007; regulation Siseministri määrus nr 1 of 2019-01-03 'Isikukoodide moodustamise ja andmise kord' (RT I, 08.01.2019, 11, amended); from 2013-01-01 serials assigned centrally in request order instead of per-hospital ranges
sources: https://www.riigiteataja.ee/akt/108012019011 (regulation; JS-only page, not read; search excerpt says 11 digits and the 11th is a check digit per the standard) ; https://www.evs.ee/et/evs-585-2007 (paid standard) ; https://et.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isikukood
design_claims: date, sex, century; mod 11 two passes; wrong check: confirmed
notes: No published test range found. Examples verified with a script: 37605030299, 34501234215, 49403136515, 49403136526 pass; 37605030298 (altered) fails. Hospital serial ranges are informal and not needed for 1.0. A 2025 draft (SK VVm 28.10.2025) moves code assignment into the residence registration procedure; it does not change the structure as far as the search excerpt shows.

label: National identity document number (NIF of Spanish nationals)
structure: NNNNNNNN (8 digits, sequential, no meaning; leading zeros allowed) + L (control letter). Display 12345678-Z or 12345678Z. The same number + letter is the person's NIF. Foreigners: NIE = X/Y/Z + 7 digits + letter (out of scope).
encodes: nothing
check: L = 'TRWAGMYFPDXBNJZSQVHLCKE'[N mod 23] (remainder 0 = T ... 22 = E; I, O, U, Ñ not used). NIE: replace X/Y/Z by 0/1/2 first.
examples: 54362315-K (python-stdnum doctest) ; 12345678-Z (widely used non-official example) ; NIE Y1234567-C (third-party guide; out of scope)
assigned: when the first DNI is issued (compulsory from age 14, available from birth); the number is kept for life
from_until: DNI since 1944/1951; control letter (NIF) since 1990; regulated by Real Decreto 1553/2005; unchanged
sources: https://www.interior.gob.es/opencms/es/servicios-al-ciudadano/tramites-y-gestiones/dni/calculo-del-digito-de-control-del-nif-nie/ (official page; 403 to scripts, not read) ; https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Documento_de_identidad_(Espa%C3%B1a) ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/stdnum.es.dni
design_claims: nothing; mod 23 letter; wrong letter: confirmed
notes: Examples verified with a script: 54362315K, 12345678Z, Y1234567C (as 134567891) pass. Numbers are allocated roughly sequentially by issue date (older people have lower numbers), which a realistic generator could model but 1.0 need not. The Interior Ministry page with the official algorithm blocks scripts; reading it by hand would raise evidence to issuer. No test range published.

label: Personal identity code
structure: DDMMYY (birth date) + X (century sign: '+' 1800s; '-' or Y, X, W, V, U 1900s; A or B, C, D, E, F 2000s) + NNN (individual number 002-899, odd = male, even = female; 900-999 not official, temporary/test) + T (check character). 11 characters, display = electronic form. Since the new signs the code is unique only as a whole string (DDMMYY+NNN+T alone is no longer unique).
encodes: date, sex, century sign
check: T = table[ int(DDMMYYNNN) mod 31 ] with table 0123456789ABCDEFHJKLMNPRSTUVWXY (remainder 10 = A ... 30 = Y; G, I, O, Q, Z not used); century sign not included in the computation
examples: 100190-999P and 100190Y999P (DVV press release: two different people differing only by century sign; individual number 999) ; 131052-308T (woman born 1952-10-13; classic Väestörekisterikeskus example, reference level)
assigned: at birth registration in the population information system (väestötietojärjestelmä), or on registration of an immigrant
safe_source: https://api.hankeikkuna.fi/asiakirjat/e4e7c20c-ab47-480e-b3da-353452c53a1a/f5894be3-b290-45a2-b48f-d30dab14fa17/KIRJE_20210708100545.PDF (HETU reform project slides, 8.7.2021: 'tunnuksen loppuosaan 002-899 väliltä, 9-alkuiset eivät virallisia tunnuksia (testikäyttöön)') ; https://stat.fi/meta/kas/hetu.html (official range 002-899)
from_until: henkilötunnus since 1964; check character table and century signs set by Government Decree 128/2010 §2 as amended by 690/2022 (in force 2023-01-01); first code with a new sign (Y) issued 2023-12-19; old signs '-' and 'A' still issued while numbers remain; existing codes unchanged
sources: https://finlex.fi/api/media/statute/17253/mainPdf/main.pdf (decree 690/2022, text of §2 incl. remainder table) ; https://stat.fi/meta/kas/hetu.html ; https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Henkil%C3%B6tunnus
design_claims: individual numbers 900-999 reserved for test use: confirmed, with nuance: 9xx codes are 'not official codes (for test use)' per the reform project slides, and fi.wikipedia says they are used as temporary codes (e.g. hospitals, newborns) that are not recorded in the population register, so a 9xx code can circulate in hospital systems but is never a person's official code ; 2023 century signs '-', Y, X, W, V, U (1900s) and A, B, C, D, E, F (2000s), '+' (1800s, no new signs): confirmed by decree 690/2022 §2
notes: The design should note that the decree took effect 2023-01-01 but the first new-sign code was issued 2023-12-19, and DVV keeps using '-' and 'A' while numbers last; per the slides new signs are used in order Y, X, W... for the 1900s and B, C, D... for the 2000s, so a realistic generator should use '-'/'A' for almost everyone and Y/B only for codes assigned from 2023-12-19. Check characters verified with a script: 100190-999P pass, 100190Y999P pass, 131052-308T pass, 100190-999R (altered) fails. DVV's own pages (dvv.fi) return 403 to scripts; the official 900-999 statement on dvv.fi was not read. Temporary 9xx codes accept the same check rule.

label: Social security number (NIR, INSEE number)
native_label: numéro d'inscription au répertoire (NIR) / numéro de sécurité sociale
structure: S (sex: 1 man, 2 woman; 3, 4, 7, 8 used for persons being registered / temporary numbers per ameli/MSA via fr.wikipedia) + YY (birth year) + MM (birth month 01-12; other codes when unknown: 20, 30-42, 50+ per ameli via fr.wikipedia) + DD (département of birth: 01-95, 2A/2B for Corsica since 1976 (20 before), 97/98 overseas followed by a 3-digit commune code that includes the third department digit, 99 for births abroad; 91-96 for Algeria/Morocco/Tunisia before independence) + CCC (INSEE commune code, or INSEE country code when DD = 99) + OOO (order number among births in the same place and month) + KK (key). Display 'S YY MM DD CCC OOO KK'; 13 characters + 2-digit key.
encodes: sex, year and month of birth, birthplace (département and commune of birth, or country of birth), sequence
check: KK = 97 - (NIR13 mod 97). Corsica: replace the letter by 0, then subtract 1,000,000 for A or 2,000,000 for B before the mod (equivalent to reading 2A as 19 and 2B as 18) (INSEE)
examples: 1510246102043 key 25 (INSEE schema example: man born Feb 1951, dept 46, commune 102, order 043) ; 278112B050002 key 86 = 278112B05000286 (INSEE schema example, woman born Nov 1978 in Haute-Corse) ; 2 95 10 99 126 111 93 (woman born Oct 1995 abroad, country 99126; python-stdnum)
assigned: at birth (INSEE registers everyone born in France in the RNIPP from the civil-status birth record); for people born abroad, on registration with social security (temporary NIA first, then a NIR)
place_codes: Communes: INSEE Code officiel géographique (COG), https://www.insee.fr/fr/information/2560452 , about 34,900 current communes plus a history file of all communes since 1943 (needed for births in merged communes); Licence Ouverte / Open Licence (Etalab) — licence not re-checked this session. Wikidata P374 'Insee municipality code' (regex [0-9][0-9AB][0-9P][0-9][0-9], covers 2A/2B). Countries: INSEE COG 'pays et territoires étrangers' 5-digit codes 99XXX (the NIR uses the last 3 digits after 99); Wikidata P3422 'INSEE countries and foreign territories code'. Overseas departments use 97x/98x with 2-digit commune suffix.
from_until: NIR since 1946 (RNIPP); 2A/2B for Corsica births from 1976 (earlier Corsican births keep 20); unchanged structure
sources: https://xml.insee.fr/schema/nir.html (INSEE: 13 digits, key = complement to 97, Corsica rule, examples) ; https://guide.reassurez-moi.fr/guide/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/regles-identification-personnes-physiques.pdf (Ministère des Affaires sociales / Économie, 'Les règles d'identification et d'immatriculation des assurés': position meanings, 97/98, 99 + INSEE country code, 91-96) ; https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Num%C3%A9ro_de_s%C3%A9curit%C3%A9_sociale_en_France
design_claims: sex, year and month, birthplace (department and commune, or country); 97 - mod 97; wrong key: confirmed ; INSEE commune codes (Wikidata P374) and INSEE country codes for births abroad: confirmed (P374; country codes are COG 99XXX, Wikidata P3422) ; Corsica 2A/2B in the NIR check: confirmed, INSEE's rule is letter -> 0 then minus 1,000,000 (A) or 2,000,000 (B), the same as 2A = 19, 2B = 18
notes: Examples verified with a script: 1510246102043/25, 278112B050002/86, 2951099126111/93, 253072A073004/43 and 253072B073004/70 (python-stdnum) all match; 295109912611199 fails. INSEE advises applications not to rely on the NIR's structure (unknown months, foreign-born codes). The ministry PDF is hosted on a third-party site (reassurez-moi.fr) but is an official ministry document. Unknown-month codes and sex digits 3/4/7/8 are rare; 1.0 can use 1/2 and real months only. Temporary NIA numbers for foreigners are out of scope.

label: National Insurance number
structure: PP (2-letter prefix) + NNNNNN (6 digits) + S (suffix A, B, C or D). Display 'QQ 12 34 56 C'. Prefix rules: D, F, I, Q, U, V never used as first or second letter; O never second letter; prefixes BG, GB, KN, NK, NT, TN, ZZ barred.
encodes: nothing (suffix historically = quarter when paper contribution cards were returned: A March, B June, C September, D December)
check: none
examples: QQ 12 34 56 A (HMRC NIM39110: 'an example only and should not be used as an actual number') ; QQ 12 34 56 C (GOV.UK 'Your National Insurance number' page format example)
assigned: automatically shortly before age 16 for children with Child Benefit records; otherwise on application (e.g. immigrants starting work)
from_until: NINO since 1948; current prefix exclusions per NIM39110; temporary 'TN' numbers no longer used as NINOs (barred prefix)
sources: https://www.gov.uk/hmrc-internal-manuals/national-insurance-manual/nim39110
design_claims: nothing; no check: confirmed ; HMRC's example prefix QQ: confirmed as HMRC's documentation example, and Q is never used in a prefix so QQ can never be allocated ; prefixes never allocated: confirmed: BG, GB, KN, NK, NT, TN, ZZ, plus any prefix with D, F, I, Q, U, V, or O as second letter
notes: Safe mode: QQ (or another barred prefix) with any 6 digits and suffix A-D; these pass naive regex validators but fail HMRC's prefix rules. Realistic mode: draw only allowed prefixes; actual allocation is concentrated in certain prefixes by era (not published here). No python-stdnum module for NINO found (stdnum.gb has vat, sedol, upn, utr only, from memory, not re-checked).

label: social security registration number
structure: DDMMYY (birth date, day first; century not encoded) + NNNS (digits 7-10: serial in the National Register for that birth date; digit 10 odd = male, even = female) + C (Luhn check). 11 digits, one block
encodes: date (2-digit year), sex
check: Luhn (mod 10) over all 11 digits
examples: 01013099997 (male born 1930-01-01; python-stdnum doctest, not authority) ; invalid: 01013099999 (wrong check). No authority-published example found
assigned: on request (application via the IDIKA/HDIKA web application, e-EFKA, KEP; third-country nationals via the Ministry of Migration from 2024-12-22); newborns in practice at birth registration (not confirmed from the KYA text). Mandatory sole insurance identifier for all from 2009
from_until: AMKA created by law 2084/1992 art. 64; mandatory for all from 2009 (law 3655/2008 art. 153); procedures replaced 2023-12-14 by law 4826/2021 art. 74 and KYA F80320/109864/2023 (FEK B 7280/22-12-2023). From 2025-06-03 Greece issues a 12-character Personal Number (Prosopikos Arithmos, built on the AFM), to be phased in alongside AFM and AMKA
sources: https://el.wikipedia.org/wiki/%CE%91%CF%81%CE%B9%CE%B8%CE%BC%CF%8C%CF%82_%CE%9C%CE%B7%CF%84%CF%81%CF%8E%CE%BF%CF%85_%CE%9A%CE%BF%CE%B9%CE%BD%CF%89%CE%BD%CE%B9%CE%BA%CE%AE%CF%82_%CE%91%CF%83%CF%86%CE%AC%CE%BB%CE%B9%CF%83%CE%B7%CF%82 (structure, odd/even, Luhn; cites the now-dead amka.gr 'what is' page) ; python-stdnum stdnum/gr/amka.py ; https://www.efka.gov.gr/sites/default/files/2024-04/%CE%93%CE%95%CE%9D%CE%99%CE%9A%CE%9F%20%CE%95%CE%93%CE%93%CE%A1%CE%91%CE%A6%CE%9F%20%CE%9F%CE%94%CE%97%CE%93%CE%99%CE%95%CE%A3%20%CE%93%CE%99%CE%91%20%CE%95%CE%9A%CE%94%CE%9F%CE%A3%CE%97%20%CE%91%CE%9C%CE%9A%CE%91.pdf (e-EFKA 530132/2024: legal basis and procedure, no structure) ; https://www.tovima.com/society/greece-launches-new-personal-citizen-number-on-june-3-what-you-need-to-know/
design_claims: encodes date, sex (survey): confirmed at reference level: DDMMYY + 4-digit serial whose last digit is odd for men, even for women; the century is not encoded ; Luhn: confirmed at reference level (el.wikipedia + python-stdnum) ; safe = wrong check: confirmed
notes: Example verified with own script: 01013099997 passes Luhn, 01013099999 fails. The issuer page (amka.gr 'what is AMKA') is dead and web.archive.org could not be fetched, so evidence is reference, not issuer. People with an unknown birth day may get conventional dates (not verified). A temporary PAMKA existed for COVID-19 (2021), out of scope. Consider the 2025 Personal Number for a later version; its exact layout (3 characters + 9-digit AFM, one character a check) is only press-reported.

label: Hong Kong identity card number
structure: L or LL (one or two prefix letters) + NNNNNN (6 digits) + (C) check character 0-9 or A in brackets; display A123456(3), electronic A1234563 (identifier 7-8 characters + check per the government data standard)
encodes: nothing (prefix letters reflect issue series / category, not personal data)
check: mod 11: pad a one-letter prefix with a leading space (value 36); letters A=10 ... Z=35; weights 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2 over the 8 positions; r = sum mod 11; check = 11 - r, with 10 -> A and 11 -> 0
examples: A123456(3) (computed by me, passes) ; B255241(3) (quoted in a third-party write-up, passes) ; invalid: A123456(A), the structural sample in the government's HKID data schema, fails the check
assigned: registration is compulsory from age 11 (juvenile card) and the adult card at 18; the number is allocated at first registration and kept for life
from_until: current shape in use since the 1980 permanent-ID series; smart card since 2003 and new smart card since 2018 keep the same number
sources: https://digitalpolicy.gov.hk/en/our_work/data_governance/policies_standards/interoperability_framework/common_schemas/hkid_number/index.html (structure: max 2 letters + 6 digits, check 0-9 or A) ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/sit-defn-hong-kong-identity-card-number ; https://github.com/KnugiHK/Hong-Kong-ID-Card-Verification-Algorithm-MultiLang
design_claims: encodes nothing: confirmed ; mod 11: confirmed (reference; the Immigration Department does not publish the algorithm) ; safe = wrong check: confirmed
notes: No authority-published valid example. Structure is issuer-level (OGCIO data standard), the check algorithm is reference-level only. Prefix letters: draw single letters weighted to common series (A, C, D, E, G, H, K, P, R, V, Y, Z ...); two-letter prefixes exist but are rare. The age column (registration at 11, adult card at 18) is from my knowledge of the Registration of Persons rules, not verified in this survey.

label: personal identification number
structure: NNNNNNNNNN (10 randomly chosen digits, no information about the holder) + C (check). 11 digits; the prefix HR is added for use abroad (Pravilnik art. 53)
encodes: nothing
check: ISO 7064 MOD 11,10
examples: 33392005961 (python-stdnum doctest, not authority) ; invalid: 33392005962 (wrong check). No authority-published worked example found (the Tax Administration's OECD sheet shows only an image)
assigned: ex officio by the Tax Administration after the first registration, i.e. birth registration for citizens (Pravilnik art. 3-5); all existing persons assigned during 2009
from_until: from 2009-01-01 (Zakon o OIB, NN 60/08; Pravilnik NN 1/09, last amended 101/25); sole identifier in tax and payments from 2010-01-01. The former JMBG/MBG (RR 30-39) still exists for people born before 2009 but is no longer used on documents
sources: https://narodne-novine.nn.hr/clanci/sluzbeni/2009_01_1_6.html (art. 2-3: random 10 digits + ISO 7064 Modul 11,10) ; https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/topics/policy-issue-focus/aeoi/croatia-tin.pdf ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Personal_identification_number_(Croatia)
design_claims: encodes nothing: confirmed ; ISO 7064 MOD 11,10: confirmed ; safe = wrong check: confirmed (no reserved range; Pravilnik reserves none and never reuses an assigned or annulled OIB)
notes: Example verified with own script: 33392005961 passes, 33392005962 fails. Only one non-authority valid example found (brief asks for two); fiscalisation demo docs may hold a test OIB but were not retrieved (a third-party site lists 02994650199 for a FINA demo certificate, unverified, not used). The Pravilnik sets no first-digit restriction, so a leading 0 is possible. Foreigners also get an OIB (same format), out of scope.

label: Population identity number (NIK)
structure: PP (province) + KK (regency/city) + CC (district, kecamatan): Kemendagri area code of residence at registration + DD (birth day, +40 for women) + MM + YY (birth month, 2-digit year, no century) + NNNN (issuance sequence from 0001, generated by SIAK); 16 digits, no separators
encodes: place (kecamatan of residence when first registered), date (no century), sex (day + 40 for women)
check: none
examples: 3171011708450001 (python-stdnum doctest; 31.71.01 = DKI Jakarta, Jakarta Selatan, kecamatan 01; born 17-08-45, male) ; 3171015708450001 (stdnum doctest; same but day 57 = 17 + 40, female, 1945-08-17) ; invalid: 9971011708450001 (province 99 does not exist)
assigned: at birth registration (entered on the family card, KK); KTP-el card from age 17 or marriage
place_codes: Kemendagri 'Kode dan Data Wilayah Administrasi Pemerintahan' decree: Kepmendagri 300.2.2-2138 Tahun 2025, amended by 300.2.2-2430 Tahun 2025 (23 June 2025); replaces 100.1.1-6117 Tahun 2022. 38 provinces, 514 regencies/cities, about 7,280 districts. Indonesian regulations are not protected by copyright (UU 28/2014 Art. 42). Wikidata P2588 (administrative code of Indonesia, Kemendagri, dotted form e.g. 12.02.09): 91,773 items, 28,224 with GeoNames ID P1566. P1588 is the different BPS (Statistics Indonesia) code and should not be used for the NIK
from_until: 16-digit NIK since 2006 (UU 23/2006 Administrasi Kependudukan; structure in PP 37/2007 Art. 37, now PP 40/2019); numbers issued before boundary changes keep the old area code
sources: PP 40/2019 (pelaksanaan UU Administrasi Kependudukan: 16 digits, 6 area + 6 birth date with +40 for women + 4 sequence), summary at https://www.komunitasbelajar.id/2019/05/pp-nomor-40-tahun-2019-tentang.html ; PP 37/2007 Art. 37 ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/stdnum.id.nik ; https://id.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nomor_Induk_Kependudukan
design_claims: encodes district, date, sex (day + 40): confirmed (issuer, PP 40/2019) ; check none: confirmed ; district code list (Kemendagri): confirmed: Kepmendagri 300.2.2-2138/2025 as amended by 300.2.2-2430/2025 ; safe = an unassigned district code: confirmed; use a regency code unused inside a real province (e.g. 31.79.xx: DKI Jakarta uses only 31.01 and 31.71-31.75) so the number still passes stdnum's province check ; Wikidata property: P2588 (Kemendagri) with GeoNames join; not P1588 (BPS)
notes: The +40 rule means female days run 41-71. The 2-digit year has no century: birth date range 1900+ needs the reference date to resolve. Kecamatan code is the residence at first registration (place_source = residence), not birthplace. The PP 40/2019 article number was not visible in the copy I read. Exact counts of regencies/districts are from the 2025 decree as commonly reported, not re-counted here; the Jakarta codes 31.01 and 31.71-31.75 are from the Kemendagri list as mirrored by Wikidata and stdnum's example.

label: Personal Public Service Number
structure: NNNNNNN (7 digits) + C (check letter) + optional second letter: pre-2013 W (married women), T or X (special), ignored by the check; from 2013 A (individuals) or H (non-individuals); from 2024 all new numbers end in B. Display 1234567FA.
encodes: nothing
check: sum = 8*d1 + 7*d2 + 6*d3 + 5*d4 + 4*d5 + 3*d6 + 2*d7, plus 9 * value(second letter) when it is A, B or H (A=1, B=2, ... H=8; W=0); C = 'WABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUV'[sum mod 23] (remainder 0 = W)
examples: 6433435F (pre-2013) ; 6433435FW (pre-2013, married woman) ; 6433435OA (2013 format, individual) — python-stdnum doctests; no authority example found
assigned: at birth registration (issued automatically to children born in Ireland since 1971 RSI scheme, PPSN since 1998), or on application to the Department of Social Protection
from_until: PPSN since 1998 (replacing the RSI number); second letter A/H from 2013; second letter B on all new numbers from 2024 (DSP email quoted on the python-stdnum list); older 8-character numbers still held
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Personal_Public_Service_Number ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/stdnum.ie.pps ; https://lists.arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum-users/2024/msg00002.html
design_claims: nothing; weighted mod 23 letter; wrong letter: confirmed, with the correction that the 2013+ second letter (A/B/H) enters the check with weight 9
notes: Examples verified with a script: 6433435F, 6433435FW, 6433435OA, 6433435IH pass; 6433435E and 6433435VH fail. Generation must pick the format by assignment date: 8 characters (optionally W) before 2013, +A 2013-2023, +B from 2024. No gov.ie page on the format was reached; evidence stays reference.

label: Identity number (Teudat Zehut number)
structure: NNNNNNNN (8 digits, left-padded with zeros) + C (check); 9 digits, often displayed 03933742-3 or without the dash; shorter historic numbers are zero-padded to 9
encodes: nothing (sequential by issue; historic series loosely reflect era and place of first registration, not decoded)
check: Luhn over the 9-digit zero-padded number: weights 1 2 1 2 1 2 1 2 1 from the left, digits of products summed, total divisible by 10. Identical to standard Luhn because the length is fixed at 9
examples: 050012343 (sample number in the he.wikipedia infobox, passes) ; 039337423 (python-stdnum doctest, passes) ; invalid: 039337422 (stdnum, wrong check)
assigned: at birth (issued at the hospital since 1952) or on immigration (at the port of entry); ID card from 16
from_until: 9-digit form with check digit since the 1970s-1980s (computerisation); older shorter numbers were zero-padded and given a check digit
sources: https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/stdnum.il.idnr ; https://he.wikipedia.org/wiki/מספר_זהות_(ישראל) ; https://www.ynet.co.il/articles/mobile/0,7340,L-4482580,00.html ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/sit-defn-israel-national-identification-number
design_claims: encodes nothing: confirmed ; Luhn variant: corrected: it is plain Luhn on the zero-padded 9 digits (the 1-2-1-2 weighting from the left equals Luhn from the right at length 9), so core's luhn serves ; safe = wrong check: confirmed
notes: Both examples pass my own Luhn code. No official gov.il algorithm page found (Population and Immigration Authority). Ynet's example of the first number (000000018) also passes but belongs to a real person, so it is not recorded as an example. Draw realistic numbers with leading digits by era (0 for older residents, 2/3 for recent ones) only if a source is found; otherwise uniform 8 digits. The ID-card age 16 is from my knowledge, not verified here.

label: Aadhaar number
structure: D (first digit 2-9) + NNNNNNNNNN (10 random digits) + C (Verhoeff check); 12 digits, displayed 2341 2341 2346, electronic without spaces
encodes: nothing (random, non-repeating)
check: Verhoeff (dihedral D5), check digit last
examples: 2341 2341 2346 (python-stdnum doctest, passes) ; invalid: 234123412347 (wrong check), 123412341234 (starts with 1), 222222222222 (palindrome, rejected by stdnum)
assigned: at enrolment, from 2010 (first numbers issued September 2010); children can enrol from birth (Baal Aadhaar)
from_until: since 2010-09
sources: UIDAI working paper 'A UID Numbering Scheme' (2010), archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20140611025606/http://uidai.gov.in/UID_PDF/Working_Papers/A_UID_Numbering_Scheme.pdf (could not open; third-party copy https://www.scribd.com/document/369894427/Uid-Numbering-Scheme-1) ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/stdnum.in_.aadhaar ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/sit-defn-india-unique-identification-number
design_claims: encodes nothing: confirmed ; Verhoeff: confirmed ; first digit never 0 or 1: confirmed (reference: stdnum and Purview; the UIDAI numbering paper reportedly reserves first digit 1 for entity UIDs) ; safe = wrong check: confirmed
notes: The example passes my own Verhoeff code. Also reject palindromes when drawing (stdnum does). A first digit 0 or 1 with a valid Verhoeff check would be a 'reserved_range' alternative, but its source is only a third-party copy of the UIDAI paper, so wrong_check stays. The 16-digit Virtual ID (stdnum.in_.vid) is a separate token. I could not open the UIDAI paper itself (web.archive.org blocked here).

label: National code
structure: OOO (3-digit code of the county/office that issued the birth certificate) + NNNNNN (6-digit serial within that office) + C (check); 10 digits, shown with dashes 773-168995-6 on cards, electronic 10 digits (leading zeros kept)
encodes: place (county of the civil-registration office that issued the birth certificate)
check: weights 10 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2 on digits 1-9; r = sum mod 11; check = r when r < 2, else 11 - r. Numbers of ten identical digits are rejected by validators
examples: 7731689956 (body 773168995 from ekhtebar.ir; check computed by me = 6, passes) ; invalid: 7731689951 (ekhtebar.ir worked example: remainder 5, check must be 6, so invalid) ; no authority-published valid example found
assigned: at birth registration (with the birth certificate, shenasnameh), by the National Organization for Civil Registration (سازمان ثبت احوال کشور); older people received codes when the scheme started (plan from 1368 / 1989)
place_codes: office codes per county (e.g. lists of 'کد شهرستان' circulate on Persian sites); no official list found in this survey. Not on Wikidata as a property
from_until: national code introduced from about 1989-1990 (plan of 1368); one format since
sources: https://www.ekhtebar.ir/%DA%A9%D8%AF%D9%85%D9%84%DB%8C-%D9%88-%DA%A9%D8%AF%D9%BE%D8%B3%D8%AA%DB%8C/ ; https://virgool.io/@geeky/%D9%86%D8%AD%D9%88%D9%87-%D8%AA%D8%B4%D8%AE%DB%8C%D8%B5-%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%AA-%DA%A9%D8%AF-%D9%85%D9%84%DB%8C-tsuiniszfpt4 ; https://www.github.com/prstwo/persian-national-code ; https://fa.wikipedia.org/wiki/کارت_ملی (issuer, 1368 plan only)
design_claims: encodes issuing office: confirmed (reference) ; mod 11: confirmed (r < 2 -> r, else 11 - r) ; safe = wrong check: confirmed
notes: No official specification found; two Persian write-ups and several open-source validators agree on the algorithm. The worked example's body passes my code once its check is corrected to 6. Without an official office-code list, generate the 3-digit office part randomly (or from an unofficial list) and treat place as not decoded. Avoid ten identical digits.

label: Icelandic identification number
structure: DDMMYY (birth date) + RR (two digits with no meaning, normally assigned in order starting at 20) + V (vartala, check digit 0-9; no longer computed for numbers issued from 2026-02-18) + C (century: 8 = 1800s, 9 = 1900s, 0 = 2000s). Display DDMMYY-RRVC; electronic 10 digits. Legal entities: day + 40 (out of scope).
encodes: date, century
check: until 2026-02-17: weights 3,2,7,6,5,4,3,2 over DDMMYYRR; r = sum mod 11; V = 0 if r = 0, else 11 - r; r = 1 (V would be 10) means the RR value is skipped. From 2026-02-18: no check digit; Þjóðskrá says all new kennitölur (individuals and kerfiskennitölur) will fail a check-digit test.
examples: 120174-3399 (born 1974-01-12, valid mod 11; en.wikipedia citing Þjóðskrá) ; Þjóðskrá test kennitölur without vartala: 281191-3049, 020980-4299, 040404-4400, 100514-8220, 241219-8560, 300322-8340 (fictitious persons with 'ÞÍ' in the name, distributed in Þjóðskrá data feeds from 2026-02-18)
assigned: at birth registration (automatically once the birth is registered), or when a foreign national is registered; kerfiskennitala for non-residents
from_until: kennitala since the 1950s-60s (Watson 2010); mod-11 vartala on all numbers issued up to 2026-02-17; from 2026-02-18 numbers are issued without a computed vartala; existing numbers unchanged
sources: https://www.skra.is/folk/eg-i-thjodskra/um-kennitolur/ ; https://www.skra.is/folk/eg-i-thjodskra/um-kennitolur/kennitolur-an-vartolu ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Icelandic_identification_number
design_claims: mod 11: corrected: mod 11 holds only for numbers issued before 2026-02-18; from that date Þjóðskrá issues kennitölur with no check digit ; safe = wrong check: corrected: a wrong check digit is no longer safe for numbers dated 2026-02-18 or later (real numbers now fail the check); Þjóðskrá publishes six fictitious test kennitölur, so safe mode should use those (test_numbers) or, for a larger pool, wrong check only for persons whose number was assigned before 2026-02-18 (birth date + assignment date before then)
notes: Design change needed: the generator must not compute a vartala for kennitölur assigned on or after 2026-02-18 (newborns, new immigrants); the 9th digit is then arbitrary. For people registered before then, mod 11 still applies. Only six test numbers, so safe mode would repeat them; a safe alternative is an impossible date. Checks with a script: 120174-3399 passes mod 11; all six test kennitölur fail mod 11 as Þjóðskrá says. Kerfiskennitala page: https://www.skra.is/folk/eg-i-thjodskra/um-kennitolur/um-kerfiskennitolur/ (not read).

label: Tax code
structure: SSS (surname: consonants then vowels then X) + NNN (given name: if 4+ consonants take 1st, 3rd, 4th; else consonants, vowels, X) + YY (birth year) + M (month letter A B C D E H L M P R S T = Jan..Dec) + DD (birth day; + 40 for women) + CCCC (Belfiore cadastral code of the birth comune, or Z + 3 digits for the foreign state of birth) + K (check letter). 16 characters, no separator. Omocodia: to separate identical codes, digits in positions 7, 8, 10, 11, 13, 14, 15 are replaced from the right by letters (0-9 -> L M N P Q R S T U V) and the check letter is recomputed.
encodes: names, date, sex (day + 40), birthplace (comune of birth or foreign state)
check: over the 15 characters, positions numbered from 1: odd positions mapped by the odd table (digits 0-9 -> 1,0,5,7,9,13,15,17,19,21; letters A-Z -> 1,0,5,7,9,13,15,17,19,21,2,4,18,20,11,3,6,8,12,14,16,10,22,25,24,23), even positions mapped by value (digits 0-9 -> 0-9, letters A-Z -> 0-25); K = letter (sum mod 26), 0 = A
examples: RSSMRA80A01H501U (Mario Rossi, man born 1980-01-01 in Rome, H501) ; VRDGFR72L21F839N (man born 1972-07-21 in Naples, F839) and its omocode VRDGFR72L21F8PVO — secondary sources (money.it, fiscomania.com), not the Agenzia
assigned: at birth registration (the comune requests it from the Anagrafe tributaria), or on request at the Agenzia delle Entrate (foreigners, adults); in use since 1977
place_codes: Italian comuni: ISTAT 'Elenco comuni italiani' CSV (https://www.istat.it/storage/codici-unita-amministrative/Elenco-comuni-italiani.csv), column 'Codice Catastale del comune', 7,896 current comuni (downloaded 2026-11-04; Roma = H501); licence CC BY 4.0 per https://www.istat.it/note-legali/ . Only current comuni: people born in suppressed or merged comuni keep the old code, so the historical list (ISTAT SITUAS 'variazioni', or the Agenzia delle Entrate 'Archivio dei Comuni e degli Stati esteri') is needed for older births. Wikidata P806 'Italian cadastre code (municipality)', regex \w\d{3}, constrained to comuni of Italy, so it does not hold the Z codes. Foreign states: Z codes (e.g. Z110 France, Z404 USA) are assigned in the cadastral/Agenzia system; ISTAT's 'Elenco codici e denominazioni delle unità territoriali estere' includes 'identification codes of the countries in use in other administrations' (https://www.istat.it/en/classification/codes-of-foreign-territorial-units/), but its ZIP returned 404 to scripts, so the Z-code column was not verified
from_until: Decreto ministeriale 23 dicembre 1976 (GU n. 345, 1976-12-29, suppl. ord.), in use since 1977; unchanged structure
